findings: The actual address element is a plain HTML input in chrome://browser/content/browser.xhtml with appearance:none, transparent background and fractional bounds. It does not require an XUL text-editor implementation.
The frontend can use a GTK nsITheme implementation distinct from the webpage Theme entry point. Hooking the existing Theme draw method alone did not paint the parent field.

Only during the owned frame background display-list build does the adapter request the existing themed-background carrier. Paint and WebRender decisions are bound at that display item and call the shared native bitmap transport. No CSS, font, border, editor or hit-test geometry is copied.
The actual NSTextField editor, pointer loop and original Gecko insertion/deletion actions are reused. Canonical values/selections and trusted DOM events stay with Gecko.
The packaged urlbar-searchbar.css uses remotecontrol plus a repeating-linear-gradient for the stripes and the robot. They are the automation indicator, not a renderer fallback.

Native offscreen fractional edges accumulated alpha between repeated readbacks. An integral native parent backing and native background clear fixes repeated redraw drift; actual native bitmap readback determines pixel rounding, including half units.
A separate resize-history probe still differed from a fresh native control along one clip edge. This checkpoint does not qualify post-resize image parity or automatic keyboard focus restoration.
